text: 5. Frank I met him through a friend, Jeff, who he was sharing a flat with. We all used to go out quite a lot, so I talked to Nicolas and got to know him very well. At some point, I had an argument with Jeff. It was about something stupid, but we basically stopped talking to each other. We're both very stubborn, and I didn't want to be first to apologize, but of course, neither did he. I regret that really. Anyway, to cut a long story short, I haven't seen Jeff for years, but I'm still friends with Nicola.
